Test: Copy integration to the client box (Docker)
Steps: From the repo folder on your laptop run: deploy/install.sh user@CLIENT_IP /path/to/config "docker restart homeassistant" (use the client's real config path and container name)
Expected result: Script ends with "✓ done" and the container restarts without errors

Test: Copy integration to the client box (HA OS)
Steps: Enable the SSH add-on, then run: deploy/install.sh root@CLIENT_IP /config "ha core restart"
Expected result: Script ends with "✓ done" and the system restarts

Steps: In configuration.yaml add:  frontend:  themes: !include_dir_merge_named themes  (if not already there). Restart.
Expected result: Restart succeeds; no configuration errors in Settings > System > Logs

Steps: In configuration.yaml set  homeassistant:  name: "Remoto – <client name>". Restart.
Expected result: Name shows as Remoto – <client name> in Settings > System > General

Steps: Replace  default_config:  with the item list from deploy/config/configuration.yaml (it leaves out zeroconf). Restart.
Expected result: Restart succeeds; all usual features (history, energy, map, etc.) still work

Steps: Admin: Settings > Devices & services > Add integration > search "Remoto Branding". Keep name Remoto and color #553D9F. Submit.
Expected result: Integration appears in the list with title Remoto, no error

Steps: Settings > People > Add person. Turn ON "Allow login", turn OFF "Administrator". Set username/password.
Expected result: Client user is created as a non-admin

Steps: Log in as the client > click the user name (bottom left) > Theme = Remoto
Expected result: Header/buttons turn Remoto purple

Steps: Open the client's address in a private/incognito window
Expected result: Teal R logo at top; purple Log in button; NO "Home Assistant" text anywhere

Steps: Look at the browser tab
Expected result: Tab shows "Remoto" with the R icon

Steps: Look under the login form
Expected result: No "Forgot password?" or "Help" links to outside websites

Steps: Log in as the client and watch the screen while it loads (refresh with Ctrl+Shift+R to see it again)
Expected result: R logo shown; NO "A project from the Open Home Foundation" footer

Steps: After login look at the top of the sidebar
Expected result: Shows "Remoto"

Steps: Open Overview, Map, Energy, Activity, History, Media, To-do lists, Notifications and the Profile page
Expected result: No "Home Assistant" text or logo on any page; tab title ends with Remoto

Steps: As the client, check the sidebar
Expected result: No Settings, Developer tools, HACS or update notices visible

Steps: Profile > Dark. Reload.
Expected result: Colors switch to dark with teal accents; still no upstream branding

Steps: Repeat 2.1 and 4.2 in Safari and Edge/Firefox
Expected result: Same results as Chrome

Steps: On Android Chrome open the address, log in, menu ⋮ > Add to Home screen / Install app
Expected result: Icon is the teal R tile; name under icon is "Remoto"

Steps: Open the app from the home screen
Expected result: Opens full screen (no address bar); splash and pages show Remoto

Steps: On iPhone Safari open the address, log in, Share > Add to Home Screen
Expected result: Suggested name is "Remoto" and the icon is the teal R tile

Steps: Open from the home screen
Expected result: Opens full screen; no Home Assistant name or App Store banner

Steps: In normal Safari (not the home-screen app) open the address
Expected result: No banner at the top suggesting the Home Assistant app

Steps: Admin: Settings > Home Assistant Cloud > Remote access > Custom domain = <client>.remoto.<ourdomain>. Add the DNS records it shows.
Expected result: Status turns active; certificate issued

Steps: On mobile data (Wi-Fi OFF) open https://<client>.remoto.<ourdomain>
Expected result: Same Remoto login and pages as on local network

Steps: Give the client only the custom domain address; check the PWA uses it
Expected result: No *.ui.nabu.casa address shown to the client

Steps: Admin: Settings > Devices & services > Remoto Branding > Configure > color #59C7C4 > Submit. Reload the client page.
Expected result: Default colors change; then set it back to #553D9F

Steps: Admin: disable the Remoto Branding integration, reload
Expected result: System works normally (stock look). Re-enable it and confirm Remoto is back

Steps: After installing a new version, open the client page on a device that used the old one
Expected result: New logo/colors appear without clearing the cache manually

Steps: Open GitHub > EKT-Tech-Org/remoto-branding > Actions > "HA compatibility"
Expected result: Latest run is green for both "pinned" and "stable". If red, do NOT upgrade; report it

Steps: Upgrade the core version, restart, then repeat tests 2.1, 3.1, 4.2 and 5.2
Expected result: All pass; note the new version number in Notes
